Hello!

My name is Sarah Hadley, and I am a PhD student in Linguistics at the University of Alberta.

My research interests include: cognitive linguistics/psycholinguistics and (mis)information processing; particularly the relationship between personality and openmindedness with veracity judgments concerning misinformation seen online. 

I am a linguist, a writing tutor, and aspiring academic.
